LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Failed: The Summary tab hit a problem and stops drawing until the game restarts. The log has the details.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_FitToColonistsT: Makes the Summary tab only as tall as its colonists need: it sits on the bottom bar, grows upwards as colonists join and shrinks as they leave. The height above is then the most it grows to; past that the list scrolls.\n\nSearching doesn't change its height, so nothing moves under the mouse while you type.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_ResetTip: Puts the window size settings back to their defaults.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_ResetNothing: The window size settings are already at their defaults.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_RowTip: Click to select this colonist and jump to them.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_WorkTemplateTip: Work templates from UI Rethemed - Work: {0}
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_SearchTip: Finds colonists by name, weapon or apparel.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_SortButtonTip: Sorted by {0}, {1}. Click a column heading to sort by it, again to reverse, and a third time for the usual order, or open this menu for every choice.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_ColonistsTip: Free colonists on every map, in caravans and in transporters, except babies.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_UncomfortableTip: Colonists outside their comfortable temperature range where they are.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_IdeoTip: Click an icon to open the ideoligion.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_HostilityTip: What each colonist does when enemies come near. Click to change it.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_BleedingTip: Time until death by blood loss: red within half a day, yellow within a day. Green shows the bleed rate per day when there's no risk of bleeding out soon. Hover for the blood left and each bleeding wound.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_InfectionTip: Infections and other diseases the body builds immunity to, such as flu, plague and malaria. Green while immunity is winning, yellow when it's winning only just, red while the disease is. With more than one, the cell shows the worst.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionClose: Immunity is winning, but only just: immune in {0}.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionSafe: Immunity is winning: the disease isn't getting worse.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionLosing: The disease is winning: fatal in {0}, before immunity.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionKeepTended: Keep it tended: untended, the disease would win.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_WeaponTip: Equipped weapons. Click one to open its info card.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ApparelTip: Worn apparel, head to toe with outer layers first. Each slot lines up down the column, with an empty box where a colonist wears nothing in it. Click one to open its info card. Sorts by the number of items worn.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_SharpTip: Overall sharp armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_BluntTip: Overall blunt armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_HeatTip: Overall heat armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ComfortTip: Comfortable temperature range, in green while the current temperature is inside it. Sorts by the lowest comfortable temperature.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_JobTip: What each colonist is doing right now, as their inspect pane says.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_MoodTip: Mood, with marks at the minor, major and extreme break thresholds: green above minor, yellow below it, red below major. A colonist having a mental break shows it in red instead. Hover for the details.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_FoodTip: How fed each colonist is: yellow below 30%, red below 15%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_RestTip: How rested each colonist is: yellow below 30%, red below 15%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_RecreationTip: Each colonist's recreation: yellow below 30%, red below 15%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_SkillsTip: A column for every skill, with its level and passion.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Page_SummaryTip: Each colonist's skills, gear, protection, mood and what they're doing.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Page_HealthTip: Each colonist's health: capacities, bleeding, infections, tending, missing and added parts, chronic and other conditions, and operations. Prisoners and animals can be listed too, in the mod settings.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_TendingTip: Listed pawns with injuries or illnesses that need tending now.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_MedicineTip: Medicine of every kind in stockpiles on your home maps.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_HealthTip: Overall health, as the colonist bar shows it: green from 80%, yellow from 40%, red below.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_PainTip: Pain level, as the Health tab shows it. Hover for what's causing it.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_CapacitiesTip: A column for every capacity, such as consciousness, moving and sight: dim at 100%, green above, yellow below, red under half. Hover for what affects each.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_TendingTip: Conditions that need tending now: red when one is bleeding, an infection or life-threatening, yellow otherwise. Shows "Tended" when every tendable condition is tended. Hover for each, with tend quality and time left.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_MedicalCareTip: The best medicine doctors may use on each pawn. Click to change it.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_SelfTendTip: Whether a colonist may tend their own injuries. Click to change it. Greyed out for colonists who can never doctor.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_MissingTip: Missing body parts, in red. Hover for each.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ImplantsTip: Prosthetics, bionics and implants. Hover for each and the body part it's in.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ChronicTip: Chronic conditions, such as a bad back, cataracts or dementia, and permanent injuries like scars. Red when one is life-threatening. Hover for each.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ConditionsTip: Other harmful conditions, such as hypothermia, heatstroke, toxic buildup, food poisoning, malnutrition and addictions, plus pregnancy. Red when one is life-threatening. Hover for each.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_OperationsTip: Queued operations. The dot is green when the next one can start, yellow when it's suspended and red when it can't start: no doctor, missing medicine or parts, or no bed. Hover for the queue and the reason. The + button adds an operation.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_OpReady: Ready: waiting for a doctor to start.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_OpNotOnMap: Not on a map, so no operation can start.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_OpNoDoctor: No one else here is assigned to {0}.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_OpNoSkilledDoctor: No one else here assigned to {0} has the skill: needs {1}.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_OpNoBed: No bed the patient can use.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_AddOperationTip: Opens the list of operations, as on the Health tab.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_PrisonersTip: Lists prisoners on the Health page after your colonists.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_AnimalsTip: Lists your animals on the Health page after your colonists and prisoners.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_ColumnsResetTip: Shows every column again, lists prisoners and stops listing animals.
